rows.jyutping: m4 hai6 A ji4 hai6 B
rows.note: This is the all-purpose way to contrast what happens with what does not happen.

example.english: We went home by bus instead of by taxi.
example.traditional: 我哋唔係搭的士，而係搭巴士返屋企。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 m4 hai6 daap3 dik1 si2 ji4 hai6 daap3 baa1 si2 faan1 uk1 kei2

rows.note: Use this when the alternative is contrary to what was expected, rather than as a neutral replacement.

example.english: Instead of raining as the forecast said, it turned sunny today.
example.traditional: 天氣預報話今日會落雨，點知反而出太陽。
example.jyutping: tin1 hei3 jyu6 bou3 waa6 gam1 jat6 wui5 lok6 jyu5 dim2 zi1 faan2 ji4 ceot1 taai3 joeng4

rows.note: Use this specifically when one person or thing is substituted for another.

example.english: Ming used an e-book instead of a paper book.
example.traditional: 阿明用電子書代替紙本書。
example.jyutping: aa3 ming4 jung6 din6 zi2 syu1 doi6 tai3 zi2 bun2 syu1
